data.exact_reserve_text: Movement arising from prior years for Claims and loss adjustment expenses (Gross) was a strengthening of GBP 15,677k in 2015. Actual development has been better than expected across most classes of business, and the claims environment, on the whole, continues to be positive, although the liability sections of the Speciality Programmes and Package Programmes accounts have seen some accelerated claim development in the year, leading to strengthening of their reserves.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 15.677 million in 2015. This was primarily driven by accelerated claim development in the liability sections of the Specialty Programmes and Package Programmes accounts, leading to reserve strengthening for these lines. However, this occurred despite generally better than expected development across most other classes of business, a positive claims environment overall, and considerably lower catastrophe losses compared to the long-term average.
raw_causal_phrases: Actual development has been better than expected across most classes of business
The liability reserves of the Speciality Programmes and Package Programmes accounts have been strengthened in recognition of accelerated claim development in the year
Major loss estimates have proven to be adequate
